steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__game; g.showScreen(null); g.mode='play'; g.player.release(); window.T=(name,x,y,sec,fn)=>{g.mode='play'; g.player.respawn({x,y}); g.player.invuln=0; g.player.maxX=x; let states=new Set(), hit=null; g.simulate(sec,(t,p)=>{states.add(p.state); if(p.state==='hit'&&!hit) hit=p.lastHit+'@'+p.pos.x.toFixed(1); return fn(t,p)}); const p=g.player; return name+': x='+p.pos.x.toFixed(2)+' y='+p.pos.y.toFixed(2)+' state='+p.state+' seen='+[...states].join(',')+' hit='+hit}; return 'ok'})()
